caption: The woman on the mat sits up and raises both arms overhead while the kneeling woman stands up and claps her hands, then both women high-five each other.
The man pushes back from the desk, stands up, stretches both arms high above his head and turns his torso left and right.

author: Loverice  Lah
caption: The woman in the brown dress and the woman in the white cardigan grab both of each other's hands and spin around together in a full circle. After they stop spinning, the woman in the white cardigan throws both arms above her head, and the woman in the brown dress jumps up and down clapping her hands.

author: Emre  Akyol
caption: The man in the white polo shirt lifts his arm and spins the woman in the floral skirt around under it. After she spins back to him, he holds her waist with one arm and dips her backwards into a deep lean while she stretches her free arm out wide.

author: braden chilton
caption: The man in the dark blue shirt and the man in the red plaid shirt let go of the metal rail. The man in the red plaid shirt raises his right hand high, and the man in the dark blue shirt jumps up and slaps it in a big high five. After the high five, both men throw their arms around each other's shoulders and sway from side to side laughing.

author: Tnarg
caption: The man in the white T-shirt throws the basketball high up into the air. The woman in the black top runs forward, jumps up with both arms stretched above her head, and catches the basketball with both hands. After she lands, the man runs to her and gives her a high five.

author: Mary Taylor
caption: The girl in the grey top and the girl in the yellow jumpsuit land from their jump, run forward toward the camera side by side, then jump high again with both arms raised and spin around in the air.

author: Andres  Ayrton
caption: The man in the dark jacket lets go of his foot and does three big jumping jacks, swinging both arms over his head. After he has already started, the woman in the mint hoodie bends forward to touch her toes with both hands, then stands up and lunges forward with both arms stretched wide.

author: Mikhail Nilov
caption: The woman in the grey shirt hands the tablet to the man in the white shirt. After he has already taken the tablet, they shake hands firmly, then both raise their fists above their heads and cheer, and the man turns around in a full circle.

author: KoolShooters
caption: The woman in the white T-shirt and the woman in the football jersey jump up and down on the yellow sofa, then both leap off the sofa onto the floor, grab each other's hands, and dance around in a circle swinging their arms.
The woman in the pink pajamas jumps up with both arms reaching toward the fairy, then spins around in a full circle. The fairy flies in a fast loop around her head and dives down past her shoulder.
The man in the white shirt steps back and swings both arms wide in surprise, then crouches down low. The fairy zooms in a wide circle around the man and then shoots straight up into the sky.

The old man with glasses throws both arms wide open and leans back in surprise, then steps forward and holds out both hands. The fairy zips upward, flies a full loop above the man's head, and dives down into his open hands.

The girl in the red sweater runs a few steps through the meadow and jumps with both arms reaching up toward the fairy. The fairy flies in a wide circle around the girl's head and swoops down low in front of her.

The man in the black hoodie drops into a deep squat and jumps up with both arms raised high. The humanoid robot bends its knees deeply and springs up with both metal arms stretched above its head, copying the man.

The woman in the green apron throws both arms up high and dances from side to side. The humanoid robot copies her, raising both white metal arms high and swaying its whole body from side to side. After they have already danced, the woman and the humanoid robot both spin around in a full circle.

The boy in the blue T-shirt runs around the orange robot in a big circle across the grass. The orange robot turns its whole body to follow him and hops up and down on its short legs. After the boy has already stopped, he jumps high with both arms raised, and the orange robot jumps up beside him.

The woman in the yellow raincoat grabs the humanoid robot's metal hand and swings their joined arms back and forth, then spins around under the robot's raised arm. The humanoid robot lifts its other arm high and turns its whole body toward the woman.
The woman stands still on the ice, then turns her head to look toward the left, while the man walks away from her across the frozen surface.

The man in the foreground walks away from the camera, the woman in the beige coat walks forward while carrying a bag, and the man in the black jacket turns his head to look at the woman walking beside him.
The man operates the forklift, initially looking forward, then turns his head to the right while steering, and finally looks forward again as he continues driving.
The man raises his arm and gestures upward, then turns to look at the woman as she walks down the steps, and the woman turns her head to look at him while walking.
The woman rides her bicycle forward, turns her head slightly to her right, and maintains a focused expression while looking ahead.
The man in the blue jacket stands still, looking forward, while the boy in the striped shirt walks from right to left, kicking a ball and then stopping to look at the camera.

The woman in the foreground stretches her arms overhead while the others, including the woman in the blue jacket and the woman in the yellow top, perform synchronized arm movements and head turns, maintaining focused expressions throughout the sequence.
The woman holds a green ball, then turns her head to look forward while the man reaches for a pink ball, and finally, the woman holds the pink ball with both hands as she looks ahead.

The woman begins with a subtle smile, then gradually widens her grin while tilting her head slightly to the side, and finally settles into a broad, joyful smile with her head turned more directly toward the camera.

The woman smiles while sitting on a swing, holding a child in a swing seat beside her, as a young girl in a dress walks past; the man stands nearby, looking away, while another person sits on a bench in the background.
The man shifts his stance slightly and turns his head to the right, maintaining a focused expression as he prepares for his next movement.
The woman kneels on the ice, then stands and skates forward while turning her head to smile, and finally skates away with her head turned back.
The man holds a basketball above his head, then kneels and extends it toward the boy, who reaches up to take it, while the woman watches them.

The man on the left turns his head to look at the others, the man on the right walks forward toward the ball, and the two boys in the center remain mostly still, with one slightly shifting his weight as they all watch the ball.

The girl sits in the hanging chair, initially reaching out with her left hand, then settles with both hands resting on the sides, and finally looks directly at the camera with a neutral expression while the man remains standing in the background.

The man in the plaid shirt walks forward with a neutral expression, the man in the light shirt walks beside him while looking ahead, and the woman in the black hijab walks past them, turning her head slightly to the right.
The man in the plaid shirt walks forward, turns his head to look at the man beside him, and then continues walking as the woman in the black outfit walks past them.
The woman leans forward to gently press on the other woman's back, then steps back with her hands open, while the other woman remains in a forward bend with her head down.
The woman smiles broadly, laughs joyfully, and moves her arms in a dynamic, energetic motion while turning her head to the side.

The man begins by smiling and gesturing with both hands toward his chest, then shifts to a more neutral stance with one hand in his pocket while looking forward, and finally turns his head slightly to the side with an open mouth as if speaking.

The woman starts by holding both hands up in a stopping gesture with a serious expression, then smiles and makes a thumbs-up gesture with her right hand while looking at the camera, and finally removes her jacket with both hands while looking upward with an amused expression.
The man skates down the ramp, crouches low as he approaches, then extends his arms outwards while turning his head to look back over his shoulder.

The woman gestures with her right hand toward the shelf while speaking, then points with both index fingers at the plants, while the other woman turns her head to look at her and responds with her own hand gestures.

The man and the woman shake hands with the woman in the suit, then the man turns his head to look at the woman while she turns to look at him, and finally, the woman gestures with her free hand as she speaks to them.
